description: This file implements a stress-testing application for disk cache crash recovery, involving process management, cache operations, multi-threading, and crash simulation.

classes.name: EntryWrapper
classes.description: Encapsulates cache entry operations such as open, read, write, delete, and manages the entry's state.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: Holds shared data for cache operations, including keys, entries, and counters.

methods.name: RunSlave
methods.description: Starts a child process with a given iteration number and returns its exit code.

methods.name: MasterCode
methods.description: Main loop that runs multiple child processes and checks for crash behavior.

methods.name: GenerateStressKey
methods.description: Generates a random key string for cache entries.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoOpen
methods.description: Initiates opening or creating a cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::OnOpenDone
methods.description: Handles completion of open/create cache entry operation.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoRead
methods.description: Reads data from a cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::OnWriteDone
methods.description: Handles completion of write operation, possibly deleting or closing the entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoIdle
methods.description: Marks the entry as idle and schedules further operations.

methods.name: LoopTask
methods.description: Keeps cache entries active by repeatedly opening and writing to entries.

methods.name: StressTheCache
methods.description: Runs the cache stress test in a separate thread, initializing cache and starting the main operation loop.

methods.name: CrashCallback
methods.description: Triggers process termination to simulate a crash.

methods.name: RunSoon
methods.description: Schedules a crash callback after a delay.

methods.name: StartCrashThread
methods.description: Starts a thread that periodically triggers crashes.

methods.name: CrashHandler
methods.description: Handles crash signals, triggers debugger break.
